facts.text: I sent a message asking the assistant to write in English.
I asked the assistant to draft articles about item number 1 in the context of residential construction in NSW, Australia.
I told the assistant that later I would refer to certain information as the Target Audience.
The target audience for my article are homeowners experiencing delays in their residential building construction.
The target audience wants to speak with a professional to get advice.
The homeowner is building their dream home with their builder.
I told the assistant that later I would refer to certain information as Information About Myself.
I am a solicitor and construction lawyer.
I have more than 10 years of experience specialising in construction law.
I regularly advise homeowners and builders regarding their contractual and legal rights.
I represent homeowners and builders in NSW, Australia.
I represent homeowners and builders in all courts of competent jurisdiction.
I have advised homeowners, builders, and contractors regarding disputes that arise from delays in residential building constructions.
I have advised them on their contract rights, risks and obligations.
I have negotiated and amended contracts to reflect their intentions.
I provided 10 common reasons that cause delays in residential building construction in NSW.
One common reason I listed for delays is when contractors have to wait for the architect to respond to a Request for Information (RFI).
I asked for a list of SEO keywords and phrases on the topic "Dealing with RFIs: How to Ensure Timely Responses from Architects and Contractors".
I asked for the SEO keyword output in a table format having a main and supporting keywords/phrases.
I asked for a topic outline for the heading "Dealing with RFIs: How to Ensure Timely Responses from Architects and Contractors".
I want the article outline to appeal to homeowners currently experiencing delays in building or renovation of the residential home.
I want a word count of 800 to 900 words.
